notes.note: Shift changes are where care details die, and 'did she take the evening meds?' is a liability-grade question agencies already pay to answer. $8/caregiver/mo is priced to be a rounding error. Boring, specific, sellable — the good kind of boring.
Handoff card generates from form inputs; mood selector OK, zero errors.
